**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The Agreement contains no audit, inspection, verification, or records-examination right exercisable by Kubient against AP. The closest responsive language is the service-delivery cooperation covenant in §1 ("all reasonable and necessary access, support and cooperation for Kubient to provide the Services"), which is not an audit right, and §6(a), which restricts rather than grants access. Since Kubient has no audit right at all — no frequency, notice, cost-shifting, or system-access exposure — AP sits above the preferred position, and we should not volunteer audit machinery that does not currently exist.
